accounting.rationale: The paragraph defines common properties of data entities and separates type/parameter/value status from rank/scalar/array classification.

A data entity has type and type parameters and might have a data value; an undefined variable is the named exception. Type and parameter rules are in 7.x and 8.x, while variable definition status is owned by 5.4.4 and Clause 19.
Every data entity has rank and is scalar or array. Array rank/shape/size declarations and inquiries are owned by 8.5.8, 9.5, and the RANK/SHAPE/SIZE intrinsic catalogues.
Names the data entity produced by a function reference as the function result. Function-result availability and characteristics are registered in 15.5.3 and 15.3.3.

review_rationale: Source registration for 5.4 and 5.4.1-5.4.6 of the Clause 5 overview: type, data value, data entity, data object, definition of objects and pointers, reference and array (batch249). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; overview definitions are cross-referenced to specific owning facets in Clauses 7-19. Source accounting only.
